post.title: Fact first
post.what: Open with the most concrete fact or number in the company's files, with no scene-setting before it.

post.title: Scene
post.what: Open inside one real moment, a site, a room or a customer's question, and let the point arrive by the third line.

post.title: Question
post.what: Open with the reader's own doubt in their words, then answer it plainly.

post.title: Contrast
post.what: Set the usual way against this company's way, one line each, then give the proof.

post.title: List
post.what: Give three to five numbered points, each a complete thought, with no introduction.

carousel.title: Type led
carousel.what: Set one large line per slide in the heading face, and show no picture before the last slide.

carousel.title: Picture led
carousel.what: Let one of the owner's pictures fill each slide edge to edge, with at most eight words over it.

carousel.title: Diagram led
carousel.what: Make a plan, a section, a number or a simple chart drawn from the facts the hero of each slide.

carousel.title: Split
carousel.what: Put a picture on half of each slide and flat brand colour on the other half, with the words on the colour.

carousel.title: Sequence
carousel.what: Use one picture or drawing that develops slide by slide, as a zoom, a build-up or a before and after.

title-card.title: Still type
title-card.what: Let the type set itself in place with one move and a long hold.

title-card.title: Reveal mask
title-card.what: Wipe a brand colour across the frame to uncover the title.

title-card.title: Kinetic
title-card.what: Bring the words in one beat at a time.

title-card.title: Line draw
title-card.what: Draw a thin line that makes a plan or a mark, then show the title.

title-card.title: Number first
title-card.what: Count one figure up on screen, then let the title explain it.

film.title: Slow approach
film.what: Make one continuous approach from far away to the door, in a few long takes.

film.title: Detail to whole
film.what: Show materials and joints close first and the whole building last.

film.title: Day of light
film.what: Show the same views from morning to dusk.

film.title: People first
film.what: Start where a person stands and show the building as their experience.

film.title: Plan to place
film.what: Dissolve a drawing or model into the built view, room by room.

page.title: Editorial
page.what: Use large heading type and a long calm scroll, with one picture a screen.

page.title: Gallery
page.what: Put full-width pictures first and use words only as captions.

page.title: Spec sheet
page.what: Lay out a strict grid of facts, plans and numbers, with pictures small and exact.

page.title: Story scroll
page.what: Tell one story in five to seven full-height sections.

page.title: Index
page.what: Make a dense page that is a table of contents, with every project a row.
